journey.name: Memory Leak Check - Chats Surface
journey.description:
Verifies that navigating into chat conversations, typing messages, opening the new chat modal, and popping navigation entries does not leak conversation state or ViewModels.
Executes 3 loop iterations with theme switches (dark/light) to trigger Activity recreation while observing LeakCanary output.

actions.action: Tap the Chats tab on the main navigation bar
Verify that the Chats conversation list is visible
Tap the first conversation in the list to open chat thread
Verify that the conversation thread screen is visible
Type text into the chat message input field
Press the system back button to return to conversation list
Verify that the Chats conversation list is visible
Verify that the user picker or new chat sheet is visible
Press the system back button to cancel new chat
Verify that the Chats conversation list is visible
Switch the device to dark theme
Switch the device back to light theme
Repeat all of the steps above two more times
Press the Home button to send the app to the background, then wait 15 seconds for LeakCanary analysis
Verify that no LeakCanary leak notification appears except for known accessibility delegate semantics cache
